outline: 本課程之教學目標在使學生瞭解電信網路之基本概念、各種設備、及技術標準，以作為學生畢業後從事電信相關行業之基礎知識，也可以作為學生繼續修習通訊相關課程之基礎。課程內容包含：(1)電信簡介 (2)數位傳輸技術 (3)數位交換系統 (4) 信號系統 (5) 光纖通訊系統 (6) 無線行動通訊
schedule:
Week1-3 Basic Telecommunication Concept
Week4-6 Transmission and Switching
Week7-9 Digital Network System
Week10 Mid-term Exam
Week11 Mobile Wireless Network Infrastructure
Week12 Wireless Network Design & RF Engineering
Week13 Wireless Network Optimization & Management
Week14 Field Measurement Practice (1)
Week15 Field Measurement Practice (2)
Week16 Final Report (1)
Week17 Final Report (2)
Week18 Final Exam
assessment:
Mid-term Exam 25%
Field Measurement Practice 25%
Final Report 25%
Final Exam 25%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

(2)Class hand-out
